question: What kind of object is said to be heard abiding in the ear when it is transmitted through a continuous tradition?
premises: Something abiding in the ear is heard.
The address is made to the goddess.
That thing is described as having come down through tradition in order.
inference: What abides in the ear and comes down through tradition is heard, as addressed to the goddess.
uncertainties: Whether the object is sound or teaching remains open
plain_english: O goddess, what abides in the ear and has come down through tradition is heard.
